statement: AMD launched the Instinct MI455X accelerator and 72-GPU Helios rack, stating the racks are in production today with OpenAI, Meta, Anthropic, Microsoft and Oracle named as adopters.
why: A rack-scale competitor in production with the largest AI buyers named is the clearest evidence yet of credible non-Nvidia accelerator capacity reaching the market.

impact.mechanism: A shipping rack-scale alternative adds accelerator supply outside the incumbent, easing allocation pressure and increasing buyer choice.

evidence.excerpt: Production status: racks 'are in production today'; named adopters: 'OpenAI, Meta, Anthropic, Microsoft, Oracle'.

confidence.basis: Single secondary trade outlet covering a vendor launch event; adopter and production claims are vendor-stated and volumes are not disclosed.
